title: Records carry retrieval keys and recall is measured (S10)
body:
Source: Fable architecture decision 2026-11-15, docs/program/plan.md S10 (Sector 3 — Retrieval (ADR 0020; items 1–3)); program t-b160jt0.
Why: ADR 0020 — moves the north-star items named in the plan sector.
Outcome: every in-force served record has stacks, paths and terms; `evals/retrieval/cases.json` holds 30 mined cases; recall@5 printed per moment
Files: see ADR 0020 Consequences.
Proof: `node evals/retrieval/run.ts: recall@5 >= 0.6 at task start`
Predicted: metric recall-at-5-task-start >= 0.6
After: S9
